tfidf.name: TF-IDF + logistic regression
tfidf.params: 1-2 grams, min_df 3, sublinear tf, 100k features, balanced classes

minilm_large.params: AdamW lr 5e-05, weight decay 0.01, linear decay, batch 16, max length 128, grad clip 1.0, seed 42
